name: 造纸术
desc: 以树皮、麻头、破布等为原料改进造纸，纸张廉价易得，成为知识传播的重要载体。
descEn: Using bark, hemp, rag and such to improve papermaking; cheap, accessible paper became a key vehicle for knowledge.
world: 8 世纪传入阿拉伯，后传入欧洲，推动世界文明进程。
worldEn: Reached Arabia in the 8th c., then Europe, advancing world civilization.

name: 印刷术
person: 雕版印刷（隋唐）· 毕昇发明活字（北宋）
personEn: Woodblock (Sui–Tang) · Bi Sheng invented movable type (Northern Song)
desc: 雕版印刷始于隋唐；北宋毕昇以胶泥制活字，书籍复制效率大幅提升。
descEn: Woodblock printing began in Sui–Tang; in the Northern Song Bi Sheng made clay movable type, hugely boosting book replication.
world: 加速知识普及，为欧洲活字印刷提供先声。
worldEn: Accelerated knowledge diffusion, preluding European movable type.

name: 火药
person: 唐代炼丹方士 · 宋代军用
desc: 唐代最早见载于炼丹著作，唐末用于军事；宋代火药武器广泛应用。
descEn: First recorded in Tang alchemical texts; used in war by late Tang; widely used in Song weapons.
world: 改变战争形态，13 世纪经蒙古西传至欧洲。
worldEn: Changed warfare; spread west to Europe via Mongols in the 13th c.

name: 指南针
person: 战国「司南」· 北宋用于航海
personEn: “Sinan” of Warring States · used for navigation in Northern Song
desc: 战国已有指向工具「司南」；北宋制成人工磁化指南针并用于航海定向。
descEn: The Warring States had the pointing tool “Sinan”; the Northern Song made an artificial magnetized compass for sea navigation.
world: 支撑远洋航行与大航海，重塑世界地理格局。
worldEn: Supported ocean voyages and the Age of Discovery, reshaping world geography.
